title: An audit question needs evidence
alt_text: OBLIGRA VERIFY RESOURCE HUB  /  07 QUESTIONS TO RECORDS An audit question needs evidence Five questions and the record evidence a reviewer should inspect. QUESTION EVIDENCE TO INSPECT 01 What happened? Workflow context 02 Who approved it? Supplied review history 03 What controls applied? Validation state 04 Was it changed? Lifecycle + integrity result 05 Does integrity hold? Verification state Inspect the facts actually supplied. A field or “verified” status alone does not answer every audit question. obligra.ai  /  Resource Hub Concept explainer · Read the linked source
editorial_note: Preserves five audit questions; review history is supplied, and change review includes the integrity result. Removes claim every answer is guaranteed to exist.
